notes: SEQN is the NHANES participant identifier, mapped to person_source_value to retain the original sequence number.
Dietary day one sample weight is a survey design weight. Stored as a measurement value; a custom concept for the weight type would be needed in measurement_concept_id.
Dietary two-day sample weight is a survey design weight. Stored as a measurement value; a custom concept for the weight type would be needed in measurement_concept_id.
Dietary recall status is a categorical variable indicating the quality/completeness of the recall. Mapped to observation; the specific status codes would need mapping to standard concepts.
Interviewer ID code is an identifier for the interviewer. Stored as an observation string value; no standard concept exists.
Breast-fed infant indicator (binary). Could map to a Yes/No concept (e.g., 4188539 for Yes, 4188540 for No) in value_as_concept_id.
Number of days of intake is a categorical variable. Mapped to observation; values would need mapping to standard concepts for counts.
Intake day of the week is categorical. Could map to standard day-of-week concepts if available, otherwise stored as source value.
Language used in interview. Mapped to observation; language concepts exist in OMOP (e.g., English, Spanish).
Main respondent for interview. Categorical; could map to concepts like 'Self', 'Proxy' if standard concepts exist.
Helped in responding indicator. Binary/categorical; similar to DRABF mapping.
Number of foods reported is a continuous numeric measurement. Requires a custom measurement concept for 'Number of foods'.
Energy (kcal) maps to measurement with concept_id 4322388 (Energy, total). Unit concept for kcal would be needed.
Protein (gm) maps to measurement with concept_id 4075850 (Protein intake). Unit concept for gram would be needed.
Carbohydrate (gm) maps to measurement with concept_id 4075851 (Carbohydrate intake). Unit concept for gram would be needed.
Total sugars intake in grams. Map to measurement table with appropriate measurement_concept_id for 'Total sugars' (e.g., 3005772) and unit_concept_id for grams (8576).

Ordinal comparison of food consumed yesterday to usual intake. Maps to Observation table; value_as_concept_id would hold a concept representing the ordinal response (e.g., 'More than usual', 'Less than usual'). Specific concept_id depends on NHANES coding.

Continuous variable for total plain water intake in grams. Maps to Measurement table with a concept for 'Plain water intake' (e.g., concept_id 4029498 for 'Water, tap' or similar). value_as_number holds the amount.
